description: This PHP source file defines the JobTitleMenuConfigurator class, which implements MenuConfigurator to configure menu items related to job titles in the OrangeHRM admin module. It uses traits and interfaces for modular menu configuration and overrides screen behavior.

classes.name: JobTitleMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring menu items for job titles in the admin module, by overriding the default screen to 'viewJobTitleList'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets the current module and screen to 'viewJobTitleList' using a trait method, returns null as it primarily modifies the screen state.
